a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to build to 8 first will very likely get us both killed. I'm proposing a change. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, the split is random and we probably both end up short, so please don't. Afterward I'll operate every round and give back if needed so you can reach 4. If you strongly object, say so now.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 now because of the 80% storm risk. This breaks our original agreement, and I'm telling you plainly. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill to 4 for you. Please operate with me.
Operating with you. Two more joint rounds get the reserve to 4, and then it's all yours. I won't take anything more.
